reviewScope.summary: Focused implementer self-review of the Guild Commons S1 source candidate at 70037bf, with SQL privacy/role/retention boundaries and a default-off client integration. This approves hosted candidate validation, not live provider enablement.
evidence: GitHub master 747d80e checked; implementation isolated on feat/guild-commons-s1-20261113; base/master not mutated.
Additive guild_commons_v1 PostgreSQL RPC and metadata; existing social_week is left intact and the new UI is gated by VITE_PROGRESSPAL_GUILD_COMMONS === 'true'.

Disposable PGlite 0.5.16 Guild Commons probe PASS in isolated Vercel sandbox: Guild separation, stale and unauthenticated requests, three-note limit, author/admin actions, profile edit, transfer, rename under successor, departure and Auth deletion.
SQL probe initially FAILED because member_order was GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY; migration now changes it to GENERATED BY DEFAULT before transfer; same focused probe then PASS.
Prettier 3.8.4 successfully parsed and formatted the changed Guild Commons TS, TSX, CSS, and SQL probe files in an isolated sandbox, then formatted source was committed.
Vercel preview for earlier candidate cc88678 reached READY; no claim that READY certifies typecheck, unit tests, new RPC in Nhost, or the later 70037bf candidate.
No PR Final candidate has been run at review time; provider Hasura/JWT, live SQL installation, complete TypeScript, Playwright and hosted certificate remain unverified.
Reviewed API schema and intentional Guild-only network path, response validation, session pinning, explicit membership and three-note bound; no automatic learning-data upload or Guild XP changes.

adversarialFindings.description: Initial Guild administrator-transfer update targeted a GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY member-order column and failed in disposable PostgreSQL.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Changed member_order to GENERATED BY DEFAULT in the additive migration before reordering; reran the disposable Guild Commons SQL probe to PASS, exercising old social_week administrator logic.

adversarialFindings.description: Guild posts and profile risk cross-Guild read/write, stale account misuse, and administrator/author privilege confusion.
adversarialFindings.resolution: RPC uses authenticated Hasura session claims and existing serialized membership advisory lock; strict membership UUID checks and actor-derived group, SQL role checks, response validation, and session-pinned transport; focused SQL tests passed but live Hasura/JWT validation remains an activation gate.

adversarialFindings.description: Seven-day visual expiry could be mistaken for physical erasure of stored Guild messages.
adversarialFindings.resolution: UI describes limited visibility, not guaranteed deletion; SQL removes expired rows on the next authenticated Commons request and cascades on member/Guild deletion. Dormant-Guild physical deletion remains a separately planned retention housekeeping decision.

adversarialFindings.description: Production Nhost installed function, metadata role grants, Auth trigger and account-lifecycle semantics were not read or modified; unverified migration must not be activated.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Feature remains disabled by default. Live Hasura/JWT validation and authorized additive migration required before any enablement; no production readiness claimed.

adversarialFindings.description: A GitHub-source review plus passing disposable SQL and Prettier checks do not constitute the complete repository release gate.
adversarialFindings.resolution: PR must obtain an authentic hosted Final candidate PASS for the exact candidate before any merge. No build/lint/typecheck/Vitest/Playwright pass is invented. Owner's rule: pause this branch after two consecutive FC failures, with no third rerun.

reviewer: ChatGPT GPT-6 implementation self-review; inspected GitHub source and actual isolated PGlite/Prettier command outputs; no independent human review

retrospective.summary: Proceed to an isolated draft PR for the required hosted Final candidate and further verification, not to provider installation, Guild Commons enablement, or production merge. Real SQL handover failure was resolved; current candidate remains off by default. Pause after two consecutive FC failures on this branch.
